scope: Independent static review of the exact neutral frame-finalizer isolation patch and its two frozen files; read six existing caller/receiver/native-oracle dependencies. No builds, tests or product edits by this reviewer. Parent execution qualification remains separate.
review_observations: An individual Evaluate error no longer ends/censors its entire page or a live sibling before the sibling finalizer can issue valid receipts.

A deterministic sorted bounded document snapshot attempts each distinct nonnil native frame once; both explicitly ordered regression cases retain the live final observation and censor the unresolved stale document at the shared boundary.
The existing two-second owned-context cancellation/close callback and physical worker/callback joins are retained; final observations remain immutable and unresolved evidence is still censored.

The unchanged actual Chromium/WebKit finality oracle retains frame identity, no-interaction availability, no provisional remainder and independent target request-count assertions. No threshold or runtime skip has been relaxed.
This patch adds no target fetch/probe, observer installation, arbitrary target script or new public contract.
